text.config.bedrockflight.title: Bedrock Flight
text.config.bedrockflight.option.flyingS:
Horizontal movement speed while flying.
Default: 0.06
text.config.bedrockflight.option.deceler:
How quickly you stop when releasing movement keys.
Lower = faster stop, Higher = longer glide.
Default: 0.65
text.config.bedrockflight.option.stopThr:
Velocity below this value is rounded to zero.
Default: 0.001
